card.gathering_arrival.text: The house is on no map you could name. Inside, every thread of your career sits in one room: the Mentor by the window, the Businessman mid-story, the Editor laughing at it, the Minister pouring. Separately, they were relationships. Together, they are a network — and you are standing in it. At the door, your driver asks about the evening.
card.gathering_arrival.right: Send the driver home. Everything is arranged.
card.gathering_strategic_project.text: "The corridor's final phase," the Minister says, and the Businessman spreads the map without being asked — they have clearly discussed this before you arrived. "One decree. Strategic exemption, single contractor, ground broken by spring. Or we let a tender introduce us all to strangers."
card.gathering_investment_conflict.text: The map is still on the table when your aide's message arrives: no greeting, just dates and figures — your stake sits precisely inside the corridor's second phase. Nobody in this room needs the reminder. That is exactly why it was sent.
card.gathering_future_support.text: "Next spring the council seat opens," the Minister says quietly — just the two of you at the balcony rail. "I will put a name forward. When I do, I would like to already know how you'll vote."
card.gathering_editor_toast_light.text: The Editor stands, glass out. "To the new generation. I ran the first profile — you all remember. Good photos." Laughter around the table. "Better questions." He holds your eye one beat longer than the joke needs.
card.gathering_editor_toast_heavy.text: The Editor stands, glass out. "To our friend here — the best stories of my career." A pause tuned like a headline. "Especially the ones we never ran." The table laughs. The Minister does not look up from pouring.
card.gathering_drink.text: The Minister fills the glass himself and sets it in front of you. "One glass. You're not going to make everyone at this table uncomfortable, are you?" The room has gone conversationally quiet — not silent. Listening.
card.gathering_drink.lock_caption: You owe too many people at this table.
card.gathering_transport_sober.text: The cold air outside is the first honest thing all evening. The city is twenty minutes away, the road empty, the keys in your pocket where you left them.
card.gathering_transport_drunk.text: The stairs move slightly more than stairs should. Outside, the night is sharp, and your own keys are somehow already in your hand — someone passed them to you as a courtesy on the way out. The city is twenty minutes away.
card.gathering_transport_drunk.left.lock: Call an outside driver to this private address.
card.gathering_transport_drunk.left.cost: Call another driver; wait forty minutes outside the gate.
card.gathering_transport_drunk.lock_capt: You sent away the discreet way out that was already waiting, then drank the glass the table poured. Calling an outsider to a house absent from every map would leave your name, the address, and the time. You owe this room too much to create that record.
